+Global toggle: set `camel.aiObservability.enabled=false` (default is `true` when a tracing or metrics backend is present). Camel Main exposes the same setting
+When using `spring-ai-chat` with only a pre-built `chatClient` (no `chatModel` on the endpoint), Camel attempts to read
+the backing Spring AI `ChatModel` via a private field on Spring AI's internal `ChatClientRequestSpec` implementation.
+That field is not public API and may change between Spring AI releases. If extraction fails, `gen_ai.system` and
+`gen_ai.request.model` span attributes may report `unknown`. Configure `chatModel` explicitly on the endpoint URI or
+component when GenAI observability is enabled so model metadata is always populated.
